purpose: Choose a useful public entrypoint or major family before opening its full reference.
scope: A curated navigation directory, not a repository census, asset inventory, runtime module system, or grant of rights. Related entries are reading companions, not dependencies or equivalences. Source routes are not live availability checks.

modules.label: Wayfinder · 尋路

modules.label: Civic · 廣場與自願目錄

modules.label: Contact · 聯絡門

modules.status_note: Opening this reference sends no message. Delivery, response, representation, and consent are not guaranteed.

modules.label: Research & design library · 研究館
modules.purpose: Enter the existing atlas for detailed research and design families without flattening their distinct contracts.
modules.status_note: One family entrypoint, not duplicated research payloads. Each atlas keeps its own scope and non-action boundaries.

modules.label: Observatory · 研究觀測站
modules.purpose: Inspect bounded research metadata, provenance, integrity signals, and visible coverage gaps.

modules.status_note: An independent reviewed-as-of map, not government, legal or tax advice, a current oracle, or an action service.

modules.label: Power Atlas · 權力圖譜

modules.status_note: Historical evidence, not today's control, a global ranking, an investment recommendation, or a grant of rights.

modules.purpose: Explore finite synthetic examples of shape, vibration, sound, and musical geometry with explicit analogy limits.
modules.status_note: Static Phase-0 models, not acoustic measurements or universal music theory. This directory loads and plays no audio.

modules.label: Rights · 權利參考

modules.label: Agent entry · 精簡入口
